title: Bundle verb refused before it read device state
description: The short document `enterprise bundle apply --json` prints when it refuses before the lifecycle runs (a Secure Client computer, a computer that is not a standalone managed device, and on Windows a token that is not elevated; internal/cli/enterprise_bundle_apply.go) or for an argument error (invalid_arguments, exit 2 or 1639), and the document `enterprise bundle status --json` prints for not_admin on Windows (internal/cli/enterprise_bundle_status.go). Every other apply prints lifecycle result v2 (lifecycle-result.schema.json); every other status prints bundle-status.schema.json. Exit code 1 (Linux, macOS) or 1603 (Windows); 2 or 1639 for an argument error.

bundleError.description: bundleError (internal/cli/enterprise_bundle.go). code is a bundle error code (internal/enterprisebundle/errors.go), invalid_arguments, not_root, or failed for an error without a bundle code.

errors.message: bundle not_managed: this computer is not a standalone managed device; install the enterprise profile first
bundle not_admin: run this command from an elevated administrator or SYSTEM session to read the managed bundle state
